reason: The plan satisfies every hard requirement (≤12 steps, exactly 12; rollback; rehearsal on non-prod data; post-cutover row-count/checksum verification; stakeholder communication; backups placed before any rehearsal or cutover) and is technically coherent and actionable for a real DBA team, though it leans on fairly standard replication-based migration mechanics without addressing some non-obvious risks like extension/permission limits on managed services or sequence/identity sync nuances.
